Overrides default java.io.Serializable by merely retrieving DateRGF.jdn. Uses DateRGF.jdn2date(int jdn, DateRGF aDate) to re-create the appropriate DateRGF object.

Note: the locally Gregorian change date will be used to create a Julian or a Gregorian calendar date.
